body:
Continuing toward Selenium bindings: net/http.prn never actually compiled (K/V generic Map for headers fails VS0's emitter, same constraint json.prn's JObject already documents) and every function called undefined helpers. Real implementation: headers as parallel Vec Strings (json.prn precedent), url-free host/port/path API (no URL parser needed by real callers), real request builder + response parser. Found and fixed 3 more real compiler/stdlib limitations along the way: lexer's \r escape gap (worked around with bare \n, verified real servers tolerate it), let can't rebind the same name twice (nested concat calls, sed.prn's idiom), boxed-scalar-vs-pointer deref distinction. Also fixed pitviper/protocol.prn's 4 call sites onto net/tcp's renamed API. Live-verified: real GET and POST round trips against the actual running IDUNA service on :8080 (200 health check, 401 bad-credential JSON error), not simulated. make test 336/336 green. PARENA commit 3ad6abb.

⚓ ☃
title: Real working HTTP client (net/http.prn) -- second half of PARENA's network I/O gap
